content: Show me the scala tympani volume of specimen ALPHA.

name: search_docs

content: Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'Show me the scala tympani volume of specimen ALPHA.'

CochleaHub does not have data for specimen **ALPHA**. The only specimen available in the dataset is **ZETA** (right temporal bone, OpenEar dataset).

For specimen ZETA, the scala tympani volume is:

| Specimen | Scala Tympani Volume | Pipeline Run | Version |
|----------|----------------------|--------------|---------|
| ZETA | 34.65 mm³ | `19ac527c-0564-4a26-b454-e4213559ce35` | 0.1.0 |

This measurement comes from the latest completed pipeline run [S3]. The value falls within the published adult cadaveric micro-CT reference range of 23–50 mm³ [Dhanasingh2021] [S2].

If you need measurements for a different specimen, please confirm whether you meant ZETA or if another specimen should be added to the dataset.
